_approach: Second-drop reset: the build out of a breakdown into a harder second drop - bar 1 stays sparse (just kick and a lone rim), bar 2 brings in an 8th ride and creeping hats, and bar 3 doubles the hats to 16ths and fires a snare pickup roll into a crash-topped final hit, announcing that the returning drop hits harder than the first. Ref: KAN Samples' DnB arrangement guide on the second build/second drop needing to 'exceed the first drop'; Point Blank's tension-and-release principles for EDM arrangement. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
